sources.title: Qwen3 Local Deployment 2026: 8B, 14B, 32B + Docker API
sources.snippet: **Qwen3 dense sizes are 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B — there is no 7B model. The closest is Qwen3-8B (pull qwen3:8b); if you searched "Qwen3 7B", you want the 8B. Qwen3's largest dense model is 32B; for a 72B-class model use Qwen2.5-72B. Qwen3 8B and 14B run reliably on consumer GPUs via Ollama or vLLM with a Docker Compose API server.
